description: A separate 12-row post-freeze synthetic workshop holdout, not a replacement for the original 20-row test. Only the sample-size contract differs; all rule, semantic, error, critical-case and regression thresholds are inherited unchanged from the pinned legacy gate snapshot.
limitations: Twelve authored synthetic variants provide less statistical evidence than the original twenty-row test and do not establish production readiness.
The contract must be selected and hashed at freeze, before generating or evaluating the holdout.
A passing workshop result never grants human or operational approval; missing or erroneous scores and critical failures remain blocking.
Existing freezes, datasets and final results are immutable and cannot be migrated to this sample contract in place.
